t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Watch for patterns to emerge between the color of gnome and the color of basket. If you start getting fewer mushrooms, choose a gnome that will get you a different basket color.

vb_textbox.text: Hi! I'm sorry to say that I could find absolutely no discernible pattern in this game. Maybe you will fare better. The advice that I received did not make any sense to me, nor did it correspond to my experience in the game. So I don't want to lead you astray. Maybe the best approach is to just play with an open mind and see if any patterns emerge. If they don't, just enjoy the cute graphics and the meditative quality of doing so much clicking. Good luck to you!
